name: Monaco Telecom DC3 / Monaco Telecom data centers
notes: Monaco Telecom states its hosting offer is based on 3 data centers in the Principality; its 2018 ISO 27001 announcement says 2,000 sqm of computer rooms across 3 data centers including Tier III DC3. Data Center Catalog lists Monaco Telecom DC3 with 12 racks and Tier 3 certification. Assigned to Fontvieille based on public DC3/address references around Avenue Albert II; MW not disclosed.

name: Monaco Cloud sovereign cloud
notes: State-backed Monaco Cloud has been operational since October 2021 and stores data in the Principality under Monegasque law. Broadcom identifies Monaco Cloud as the operator of Monaco's sovereign cloud with one Monaco data-center location and contact address at 9 avenue Albert II; Telis references Monaco Cloud as a hosting destination. Treated as a sovereign cloud/data-center project; MW not disclosed.

name: MonacoDATACENTER / Telis Datacenter
notes: Telis says MonacoDATACENTER was created in 2013 as Monaco's first green datacenter and reports 100% availability since inauguration. Telis/Actis sources note ISO 27001/HDS certification and seawater free-cooling. DataCenterPlatform lists Telis Datacenter at 14 Av. de Grande Bretagne, which is assigned here to Monte-Carlo. MW not disclosed.

name: Monaco Telecom Larvotto Superieur data center
developer: Monaco Telecom / Direction des Travaux Publics
notes: Larvotto Superieur is a 35-apartment public-housing project at 19 Boulevard du Larvotto with a Monaco Telecom data center in lower/subterranean levels. DCD reported 1,550 sqm and a 2027 completion target; ABBA lists 2022-2027; DCmag reported in 2026 that the data-center area is 1,318 sqm with a 2028 objective. MW not disclosed.
